title: Cursor Adds Desktop App Control to its AI Agents
summary:
The AI code editor Cursor released a tool called "Computer Use" that allows its agents to click and type within any application on a user's desktop. The new capability, available via a software update, extends the agents' reach beyond the web browser to the entire operating system.

The feature allows developers to use agents to operate apps such as the iOS Simulator for testing built features. Cursor agents can invoke the tool automatically when a task requires it, or users can manually trigger the function by @-mentioning "Computer Use" in a prompt.
